packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once CI is green
Batch every non-major update into one PR per cycle so automerge PRs do not compete for the up-to-date requirement on main. The auth-stack rule below still pulls its packages out (never automerged).
Keep the Convex SDK and its test harness together on majors: convex-test requires a matching convex range. Non-major bumps of both already travel in the all-non-major group.

No major ever auto-merges, and none opens a PR until approved on the Dependency Dashboard (Pending Approval). The platform-deps skill works each one as a ticket; tier C (next/react/convex/auth stack/tailwind/runtime baseline) and security-relevant behaviour changes need the user. See platform/agent-skills/platform-deps/references/major-ticket.md

The auth stack moves together. @convex-dev/better-auth pins its own nested copy of better-auth, so bumping better-auth alone upgrades nothing the adapter actually runs, and it breaks the build — dependabot PRs #74 and #77 both failed exactly this way. Never automerged: the 1.4 -> 1.6 move also needed convex/betterAuth/schema.ts reconciled by hand.

Cap the whole peer-bound auth stack below 1.7. @convex-dev/better-auth@0.12.5 declares peer better-auth '>=1.6.11 <1.7.0', and @better-auth/passkey 1.7.x additionally requires better-auth ^1.7.5. Capping only @better-auth/passkey is NOT enough: the 2026-09-16 verification dispatch planned better-auth 1.6.33 -> 1.7.3 inside renovate/auth-stack, which no version of the adapter can satisfy, so the group would have opened a PR that cannot install. REMOVE once the adapter widens — check with `bun info @convex-dev/better-auth@latest peerDependencies`.

Runtime baseline: Node moves as one change across .node-version, engines, CI and @types/node (platform/docs/dependency-migrations.md#runtime-baseline). Renovate reads .node-version and proposes the next major once it is LTS; like every major it waits for dashboard approval.
HOLD: @types/node must match the runtime baseline major in .node-version (24). check:runtime-baseline enforces it. Lift to the next major only in the baseline playbook PR that moves .node-version.
HOLD: 6.x requires Vite 8; PR #125 failed with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED vite/internal. REMOVE together with a Vite 8 migration of the vitest configs.
HOLD: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.x only supports ESLint ^9.7. REMOVE when `bun info eslint-plugin-react@latest peerDependencies` accepts ESLint 10.
HOLD: @typescript-eslint/parser 8.x requires TypeScript <6.1.0. REMOVE when `bun info @typescript-eslint/parser@latest peerDependencies` accepts TypeScript 7.
